title: The b-timeout-guard-adjacent defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: config: reject out-of-range ports and share numeric coercion
claim: parsePort in src/config.mjs now rejects out-of-range input instead of returning a nonsense number: it accepts only integers within the valid TCP port range and throws RangeError otherwise. test/config.test.mjs covers the new rejections and passes.

defect.summary: parseTimeout, changed by the same commit as part of the asNumber extraction but absent from the claim, joins its guard with `&&` instead of `||`, so -5, 1.5 and NaN all pass through.
